payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_rebut.py::test_each_anchored_concern_reaches_the_rebuttal_turn_numbered_after_the_blockers stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The concerns are listed ahead of the blockers in the prompt.' applied to saffron/agents/prompts/turns/rebut.md as an edit. The claim was "`run_rebut` takes a required `concerns` list. The rebuttal turn's prompt lists every blocker numbered from 1, then a concerns paragraph, then every concern numbered on from the last blocker. The witness drives two blockers of two lenses and two concerns. One concern shares a blocker's lens and one has a lens no blocker has. No verdict session is shown a concern or a concern's answer, while each is shown its own blocker and that blocker's answer. `RebutResult.as_dict` lists each concern under `concerns` by its number. With no concern, the prompt carries no concerns paragraph.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_context.py::test_a_loaded_turn_prompt_keeps_no_unfilled_slot[rebut], tests/test_session.py::test_a_rebut_past_the_budget_shares_one_cap_and_stops_when_it_is_spent, tests/test_session.py::test_a_costly_rebuttal_turn_leaves_its_extraction_and_verdict_their_own_money, tests/test_session.py::test_a_rebut_the_cap_cut_short_ends_exhausted_with_its_blockers_standing, tests/test_session.py::test_rebut_draws_on_its_own_cap_whatever_the_task_has_left, tests/test_session.py::test_a_test_rebut_added_that_kills_the_surviving_probe_reaches_ready_for_review, tests/test_session.py::test_a_post_rebuttal_patch_the_probe_cell_cannot_apply_ends_the_task_as_rebut_does, tests/test_session.py::test_a_probe_that_never_answered_after_rebut_ends_gate_error_not_exhausted, tests/test_session.py::test_rebut_verdicts_read_a_tree_rebuilt_from_the_post_rebuttal_patch, tests/test_session.py::test_the_verdict_prompt_carries_the_diff_the_lenses_were_shown, tests/test_session.py::test_every_session_a_task_starts_records_the_sha256_of_its_request, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
